name: kh-uaf
description: KH UAF provides semantically selected workflow skills, optional governed runtime audits, scoped state, development progress state, role-based orchestration, and role-based task command packets for Codex, Antigravity-style agents, Claude Code, and local workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Personal skillbook with lightweight semantic routing.
interface.longDescription: KH UAF packages host-readable workflow skills, optional runtime gates, scoped memory, token telemetry, role orchestration, GoalState, progress state, and quality checks. Its front door uses host semantic selection for ordinary work and reserves Python routing for explicit audits, unresolved provider conflicts, and governed high-risk or large workflows. Before any Git executable, KH runs a filesystem-only workspace gate against the exact target. Non-Git targets run no Git/GitHub commands or retries.
defaultPrompt: Review this repository and identify the highest-risk issues before making changes.
Help me plan a new workflow, ask the necessary questions, and wait for approval before implementation.
Format this SQL without changing behavior, then explain the verification evidence.
